findings.current: Identification plate no longer required post-RVSA - RAV entry replaces it

findings.current: ADR 98/02 (AEB incl. pedestrian/cyclist) ... ADR 107 (ELKS) ... ADR 114 (CO2 measurement)

findings.current: Vehicle Exhaust Emissions Rule (Euro 6 / JP / US equivalents)

findings.evidence: 'New Zealand currently accepts Euro 5 on new vehicles and Euro 4 on used vehicles'; 'Euro 6d will be required from July 1, 2027 [new models] ... July 1, 2028'. (Land Transport Rule: Vehicle Exhaust Emissions Amendment 2023)
